title: Bloodmyst Isle
body: Bloodmyst Isle, the northern of the two isles, was named Silvergale by the draenei for its beauty. Long ago it belonged to the night elves of Loreth'Aran, whose ruins still crumble on its eastern shore. When the Exodar fell, crystal shards rained across the island and a great power core lodged in its western mountains, and the waters turned red. Worse, the blood elves who fought the draenei aboard the ship survived the crash, and hold the west. Against them stands Blood Watch.

title: Kessel's Crossing
body: Kessel's Crossing is the draenei camp where the road north from Azuremyst reaches Bloodmyst, and where recruits to the Hand of Argus are tested by Kessel, lord of the elekk. His tests are hard by design. Heavy-handed violence is not the draenei way, he says, but his people learned what reluctance costs when the orcs slaughtered them, and honorable people cannot always act honorably.

title: Blood Watch
body: Blood Watch is the forward base of the Hand of Argus on Bloodmyst, led by Exarch Admetius with the three vindicators of the Triumvirate. Admetius asks every recruit what Argus means to them, for many draenei barely remember the world where their people split from the man'ari. Its inn is a salvaged pod, a captured blood elf sits in its makeshift prison, and the Stillpine keep an ambassador here.

title: Loreth'Aran and Wyrmscar Island
body: Ten thousand years ago the night elf city of Loreth'Aran stood on Bloodmyst's eastern shore, and its riders flew green dragons given by Ysera. Deathwing's black dragonflight fell on it as it slept, the greens died defending their riders, and the Sundering broke the land apart. On Wyrmscar Island the dragons' bones still lie, their spirits unable to pass into the Dream, and the ghost of Prince Toreth keeps watch, the last keeper of his people's history.

title: The Bloodcursed Reef
body: Off the northeast coast lies the Bloodcursed Reef, where a curse has sunk ship after ship and the drowned do not rest. On Bloodcurse Isle to the south the naga keep a shrine around a statue of their queen, Azshara. The ghost of Captain Edward Hanes, once captain of the lost ship Lost Hope, lingers on Wyrmscar Island and means to free the souls the curse still holds.

parts.body: With the naga's leader slain before Azshara's burning statue the curse was ended, and the hundreds of souls it had held were set free.

title: The Cryo-Core
body: West of Blood Watch lies the Cryo-Core, a section of the Exodar that held stasis pods and medical stores. The draenei hoped to find more of their people alive in it, but blood elf reclaimers strip the wreck of anything of value and the dead lie where they fell. Morae, the herbalist of Blood Watch, waits for word of her husband Galaen, a technician who worked there.

parts.body: Galaen survived the crash only to be murdered by the infiltrators. His journal told how the blood elves held Vindicator Saruan of the Triumvirate and beat him until he lost his senses.

title: The Vector Coil
body: The Vector Coil is a colossal power core of the Exodar that lodged in the mountains of western Bloodmyst, a great red crystal still jutting from the slope. The blood elves have made it their stronghold, and their agents swarm its paths. Below it, on consecrated ground, the small outpost of Vindicator's Rest keeps watch, badly outnumbered.

parts.body: The island's water has turned red from core fluid leaking out of the Vector Coil, and the blood elves turn the poison to their advantage.
sources: quest 9759 description (power core jutting out of the mountainside)

parts.body: Explosives set at the Coil's supports broke the beams in which Sironas hung siphoning its energy, and she was slain.
